lead: An item names one of its stage's checks, and the stage names the rest — including ones in another crate.
body: The orientation pack prints the item, not the stage, so a `cargo-named` check over a second crate whose test has never been written is the same slice's, and the driver stops at the first failure, holding the whole acceptance list at that stage. One `grep -n -i <topic> docs/agent/loop-goal.toml` before starting lists every check the slice owes.
